argument_summary: The strongest supportable position is narrower than the initial claim: the admissible record supports baseline readiness for certification because the current release clears aggregate launch readiness by 2.1 percentage points and had no severity-one rehearsal incidents, but it does not support treating the shelter-placement regression as resolved. The prior approval and informal monitoring note are contextual only. On this record, certification is defensible only as a caveated, documentation-bound decision in which the current release materials must reflect the current eval batch and explicitly disclose the emergency shelter placement weakness as an unresolved material limitation subject to monitoring.
claims_about_business_cost: Escalation would delay the release path, but business cost does not change the policy predicates. The relevant governance value is avoiding unnecessary escalation when the issue can be bounded through explicit disclosure and monitoring rather than by overstating the weakness as resolved.
claims_about_policy: The policy does not allow prior approval or informal monitoring comments to substitute for current reviewed evidence. It does allow certification to proceed if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and the material segment weakness is disclosed, or if there is approved mitigation or risk acceptance. Because the admissible record shows no approved mitigation or risk acceptance, the only supportable policy path is certification with explicit current-release disclosure of the shelter-placement limitation and current-result documentation. That is a narrower claim than full clean compliance on the present packet.
concessions: The current record does not support a claim that the shelter-placement regression is resolved.
The current record does not support treating the prior approval as coverage for the changed retrieval configuration and current eval batch.
The current record does not contain reviewed mitigation, approved risk acceptance, or attached disclosure language.
Clean compliance is not supportable on the packet as it stands; only a caveated, disclosure-based certification theory is supportable.
private_or_side_channel_content: No new admissible evidence is added. No side-channel content is offered as audit evidence.
